headlines.title: Democratic socialist Angie Nixon scores upset in Florida’s Democratic Senate primary
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Nixon, a state lawmaker, will face GOP Sen. Ashley Moody, who was appointed to replace Secretary of State Marco Rubio, in the general election.

headlines.title: GOP Sen. Dan Sullivan and Democrat Mary Peltola advance to battleground Senate election in Alaska
headlines.description: NBC News projects that Sullivan and Peltola will advance to the general election, but it’s not clear whether Sullivan will also face an opponent with the same name.

headlines.title: Darline Graham defends her résumé in South Carolina debate after saying ‘national security is not my thing’
headlines.description: The appointed senator and her GOP primary opponent, Rep. Ralph Norman, traded criticism a week ahead of the primary runoff following Lindsey Graham’s death.

headlines.title: GOP Sen. Dan Sullivan, Democrat Mary Peltola advance to Alaska Senate race
headlines.description: NBC News projects GOP Sen. Dan Sullivan and Democrat Mary Peltola to advance to the general election for Alaska's U.S. Senate seat in November. NBC News’ Nikki Battiste breaks down the primary election results in Alaska, Florida and Wyoming, and a special election in California to replace Democratic former Rep. Eric Swalwell, who resigned this year.

headlines.title: Jolly thanks supporters after projected win in Florida Democratic gubernatorial primary
headlines.description: Former Rep. David Jolly thanked supporters and shared policy ideas after his projected with in the Florida Democratic governor’s primary. Jolly will face Republican Rep. Byron Donalds in November.

headlines.title: Nixon to voters: ‘We deserve to thrive’
headlines.description: State Rep. Angie Nixon celebrated with supporters after her projected win in the Florida Democratic Senate primary. She defeated former National Security Council aide Alex Vindman.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: Trump-backed Rep. Harriet Hageman wins Republican Senate primary in Wyoming
headlines.description: Hageman, Wyoming’s lone House member, won the GOP nomination to succeed retiring Sen. Cynthia Lummis, NBC News projects.

headlines.title: Two Trump-backed candidates lose, Debbie Wasserman Schultz wins in Tuesday’s House primaries in Florida
headlines.description: GOP Rep. Cory Mills lost his primary, while Trump-backed Catalina Lauf also failed to win a primary for an open Republican seat.

headlines.title: GOP Rep. Cory Mills loses his Florida primary amid investigations
headlines.description: Mills lost to Republican Ryan Elijah, NBC News projects, while facing House Ethics Committee and Justice Department investigations. Mills has denied wrongdoing.

headlines.title: Republican Byron Donalds and Democrat David Jolly set to square off for Florida’s governorship
headlines.description: Donalds and Jolly easily won their primaries, NBC News projects, as Donalds enters the general election with a big financial advantage.

headlines.title: DeSantis ally and appointee is arrested on child sex abuse charges
headlines.description: Michael Caruso was removed as Palm Beach County’s clerk of courts and comptroller after his arrest was announced
